paragraphs.text: Bitsy , the Pride of Hull Clade , is a Simic krasis from Ravnica with genetic material from crocodiles , elk and turtles .

Much of the Simic Combine fell victim to compleation during the New Phyrexian Invasion , affecting not only the researchers working with mutagens but also their experimental subjects. Following the defeat of New Phyrexia , the surviving members of the Simic discovered that only a small number of their experimental creatures had avoided corruption by the glistening oil and subsequent compleation . Among these rare survivors was a remarkable hybrid being, combining features of a crocodile, an elk, and a turtle. This creature had cleverly defended itself against the Phyrexian invaders by using its antlers to throw debris at its attackers and crushing them before they could make contact. The Hull Clade has since embraced this resilient hybrid as an informal emblem, affectionately naming it "Bitsy" because of its habit of tearing its food into pieces before consuming it.
